user.title: Connect to Sonos Web
user.description: Sign in at play.sonos.com. In your browser's Network panel, copy the Cookie request header from GET /api/control/households. Paste it here to find your speakers.

players.title: Choose speakers to restart
players.description: Home Assistant will create a restart button for each speaker you select. Setup only reads the list of speakers.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Sonos Web
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again at play.sonos.com with the account that owns this Sonos system, then paste a fresh Cookie request header.

reconfigure.title: Change speakers
reconfigure.description: Select which speakers should have a restart button. Deselecting a speaker removes its button and can affect automations that target it.

error.invalid_cookie: Paste a single Cookie request header from Sonos Web.
error.invalid_auth: Sonos declined the session. Sign in at play.sonos.com and copy a fresh Cookie request header.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not read the Sonos system. Check internet access and try again.
error.wrong_household: This session does not have access to the configured Sonos system.
error.select_players: Select at least one speaker from the list.

abort.already_configured: This Sonos system is already configured.
abort.invalid_auth: Sonos declined the session. Sign in at play.sonos.com and try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not read the speaker list. Check internet access and try again.
abort.no_households: The Sonos session has no available systems.
abort.no_players: Sonos Web did not list any eligible speakers in this system.
abort.reauth_required: Reconnect to Sonos Web before changing the speaker selection.

session_expired.message: The Sonos Web session expired. Reconnect the integration in Settings.

permission_denied.message: Sonos denied permission to restart this speaker. Check that the session belongs to the system owner.

restart_pending.message: A restart was recently requested for this speaker. Give the speaker two minutes to reconnect.

restart_rejected.message: Sonos rejected the restart request. Check that this speaker is connected to Sonos Web.

restart_unconfirmed.message: The restart outcome is unknown. Check the speaker before trying again. Home Assistant did not retry the request.
